Kagiso Rabada Achieves Historic 600 International Wickets and 350 Test Scalps

01 Nov 2026, 10:34 PM IST · GlobeWire Daily Editorial Desk · Source: www.amarujala.com

2 min read

Key takeawaysSouth African fast bowler Kagiso Rabada has reached two significant milestones in international cricket during the ongoing Test match against Australia. Milestone Achievement in Test Cricket

South African fast bowler Kagiso Rabada has reached two significant milestones in international cricket during the ongoing Test match against Australia. By dismissing Australian opener Travis Head, Rabada officially surpassed 600 international wickets and recorded his 350th Test match scalp.

Career Statistics and Records

According to the reported match data, Rabada achieved the 350-wicket mark in Test cricket during his 75th appearance. Key details regarding this achievement include:

  • International Milestone: Rabada is now the fifth South African bowler to reach the 600-wicket mark across all international formats.
  • Test Efficiency: Rabada reached the 350-wicket milestone using only 13,808 deliveries, making him the fastest bowler in Test history to reach this specific tally in terms of balls bowled.
  • Test Match Comparisons: He reached the 350-wicket mark in 75 matches, placing him alongside West Indian legend Malcolm Marshall in the list of players to achieve this feat at that stage of their careers.

Historical Context

While Rabada leads in balls bowled to reach 350 wickets, other legendary fast bowlers have reached the milestone in fewer Test matches. Richard Hadlee and Dale Steyn remain joint-fastest in terms of match count, having both achieved the feat in 69 Tests. Dennis Lillee (70) and Glenn McGrath (74) also reached the mark before Rabada.

Verification

Readers can verify these statistics by consulting official cricket boards or authorized sports statistical databases such as ESPNcricinfo or the ICC official website, which track career data and ball-by-ball analysis for international matches.
